$comment: Anti-patterns for enhanced prompts. Used by scripts/validate.mjs (rules with selfCheck: true are applied to prompt-engine's own instruction files) and by the MCP server's check_prompt tool. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions; 'flags' are passed to new RegExp().

rules.message: Capitalized pressure words make current models over-apply the rule. Write it plainly and give the reason; keep 'always' and 'never' for true invariants.

rules.pattern: think step by step|<thinking>|show your (reasoning|thinking)|chain[- ]of[- ]thought|scratchpad|explain your reasoning before
rules.message: Asks the model to expose its internal reasoning. Current Claude models may refuse this, and reasoning models don't need it. Ask for the result plus a brief explanation or evidence instead.

rules.pattern: take a deep breath|think (really )?hard|you are (a|an) world[- ]class|this is very important to my career
rules.message: Magic phrases and generic personas add little. Use effort or reasoning settings where available, and a specific role only when it changes the answer.
Prefilled assistant turns are an API setting, and current Claude models don't support them. Describe the output format instead.
An unfilled template variable. Replace it, or use a [[placeholder]] the user knows to fill.
Placeholder still open. List it under 'Fill before running' and fill it before the prompt is used.
Generic quality tags carry little meaning for natural-language image and video models. Name concrete materials, light sources and framing instead.
